questions.q: A rise in Bank Rate is likely to cause:
options: A lower AD and lower inflation
A higher AD and higher inflation
questions.why: Borrowing falls and saving rises, so AD falls.

questions.q: Why does a rise in UK interest rates tend to raise the value of the pound?
options: Foreign savers want to buy UK assets
questions.why: This raises demand for the pound.

questions.q: In quantitative easing, the central bank:
options: Creates money to buy bonds, which lowers long-term interest rates
questions.why: Higher bond prices mean lower yields.

questions.q: Forward guidance works by influencing expectations.
questions.why: People act on what they expect rates to do.

questions.q: Match each instrument to its description.
pairs: Cheap funding for banks that keep lending
Saying where rates are likely to go
questions.why: These are recent tools alongside Bank Rate.

questions.q: Explain how quantitative easing could increase aggregate demand.

ideas.label: Buying bonds raises their prices and lowers yields or interest rates
So borrowing and spending rise, which raises AD

questions.model: Buying bonds raises their prices and lowers yields, so long-term interest rates fall. Borrowing is cheaper, so consumption and investment rise, which raises AD.
questions.why: Bond prices up, yields down, spending up.

tests.answer: It lowers long-term interest rates, so consumption and investment rise.
